source.preservation: structured_transcription_from_conversation; no original file attachment was supplied

source_reported_inputs.note: Calculation-grade inputs are encoded in the source transcript and expected/comparison records for this validation campaign.

source_consistency_findings.description: The source properties list gross Wx=766400 and Wy=86600 mm3, but the checks use Wxn=70000 and Wyn=700000 mm3 without derivation; Wyn is over eight times the listed gross Wy.
36DB1 is an open I-section, while the report later labels the section closed.
One source line multiplies alpha a second time after tau was already alpha-adjusted.
Phase 0.26 recomputes the full Eq.(44) equivalent stress with adjusted tau, not only the separate shear utilization.

validation_classification.reason: This campaign preserves source discrepancies and only promotes directly comparable scalar/procedure evidence.
